points.title: 描述过去的旅行
points.explain: last weekend 等时间提示动作发生在过去。规则动词一般加 -ed，如 climb → climbed。go、see、eat、take 的过去式分别是 went、saw、ate、took。

examples.en: We went to Xi'an and ate some noodles.
examples.zh: 我们去了西安，吃了些面条。

questions.q: I ______ Mount Taishan last Saturday.
questions.e: last Saturday 指过去，climb 用过去式 climbed。

questions.q: We ______ (see) the old city wall yesterday.
questions.e: see 的过去式是 saw。

questions.q: Amy ______ (take) some photos last weekend.
questions.e: take 的过去式是 took。

points.title: 询问旅行去了哪里、做了什么
points.explain: 用 Where did you go? 问去处，用 What did you do there? 问活动。did 后面接动词原形，回答时用过去式。

examples.en: Where did you go over the holidays? — I went to Wuhan.
examples.zh: 你假期去了哪里？——我去了武汉。

questions.q:
— ______ did you go?
— I went to Wuhan.
questions.e: 答语说去了武汉，问去处用 Where。

questions.q: What did you ______ (do) there?
questions.e: 助动词 did 已经表示过去，后面用原形 do。
Where + did + 主语 + 动词原形。

points.title: 用 Did 询问过去的活动
points.explain: 一般疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形。简短肯定回答用 Yes, … did.，否定回答用 No, … didn't.。

examples.en: Did you eat mooncakes? — No, we didn't.

questions.q: Did you ______ down to midnight?
questions.e: Did 后用动词原形 count。

questions.q:
— Did they dress in red?
— Yes, they ______.
questions.e: Did 开头的疑问句用 did 作简短肯定回答。

questions.q:
— Did she run in the race?
— ______ She watched it.
questions.e: 她观看了比赛，因此否定回答用 No, she didn't.。

points.title: 按顺序讲述节庆和活动
points.explain: 用 first、then、later 交代先后。回顾活动时注意不规则过去式，如 run → ran、sing → sang、wear → wore、win → won。

examples.en: First, we watched the race. Then we sang together.
examples.zh: 我们先看了比赛，然后一起唱歌。

questions.q: We ______ (sing) some songs at the gala.
questions.e: sing 的过去式是 sang。

questions.q: Our team ______ the race yesterday.
questions.e: 昨天发生的动作要用 win 的过去式 won。

questions.q: First we put on our shoes. ______ we ran the race.
questions.e: Then 或 Later 都能说明接下来发生了什么。

points.title: 用 should 和 shouldn't 提建议
points.explain: should 表示「应该」，shouldn't 表示「不应该」。两者后面都接动词原形。

examples.en: You should get enough sleep. You shouldn't stay up late.
examples.zh: 你应该睡够，不应该熬夜。

questions.q: You have a fever. You should ______ a doctor.
questions.e: 情态动词 should 后用原形 see。

questions.q: You ______ (should not) stay up late.
questions.e: should not 可以缩写为 shouldn't。
先说主语 You，再用 should + 动词原形。

points.title: 询问身体状况
points.explain: 用 What's the matter? 或 What's wrong? 询问哪里不舒服。可以用 I have a cold / a fever / a cough 说明症状，再用 I'm sorry to hear that 表达关心。

examples.en: What's the matter? — I have a bad cold.
examples.zh: 你怎么了？——我感冒很严重。

questions.q:
— What's the matter?
— ______
questions.e: I have a runny nose. 表示「我流鼻涕」，能回答身体状况。

questions.q: I feel ill. I ______ a fever.
questions.e: have a fever 是「发烧」的固定表达。

questions.q:
— I have a bad cough.
— ______
questions.e: 听说对方不舒服时，可以用 I'm sorry to hear that. 表示关心。

points.title: 用 be going to 表达计划
points.explain: 用 am / is / are going to + 动词原形，说打算做的事。I 搭配 am，she/he 搭配 is，you/we/they 搭配 are。

examples.en: I'm going to save up for a microscope.
examples.zh: 我打算攒钱买一台显微镜。

questions.q: She ______ going to save up for a bike.
questions.e: 主语是 She，be 动词用 is。

questions.q: We are going to ______ (buy) a dictionary.
questions.e: going to 后接动词原形。

questions.a: I am going to save money.
questions.e: I + am going to + 动词原形。

points.title: 谈论钱怎么花
points.explain: 用 How do you spend your money? 问钱怎么花。用 use … to + 动词原形说明用途。save up for 后面可以接想买的物品。

examples.en: We use money to buy goods and pay for services.
examples.zh: 我们用钱购买商品和支付服务费用。

questions.q: We use money ______ buy a ticket.
questions.e: 用 to buy 说明用钱的目的。

questions.q: I want to save up ______ a computer.
questions.e: save up for a computer 表示攒钱买电脑。

questions.q:
— How do you spend your pocket money?
— ______
o: I buy books and save the rest.
questions.e: 答语要说钱怎么花或怎么存。

points.title: 用一般现在时描述太空事实
points.explain: 介绍恒常事实通常用一般现在时。Earth、the Moon 等单数主语后，实义动词用第三人称单数形式。复数主语后用原形。

questions.q: Earth ______ around the Sun.
questions.e: 主语 Earth 是单数，恒常事实用 travels。

questions.q: The Sun ______ (give) us light.
questions.e: 主语 The Sun 是单数，give 加 -s。

questions.q: Astronauts ______ (travel) into space.
questions.e: Astronauts 是复数，动词用原形。

points.title: 介绍太空里有什么
points.explain: There is 后接单数名词或不可数名词，There are 后接复数名词。把 is 或 are 提到句首，可以询问是否存在某事物。

examples.en: Are there any stars in the sky? — Yes, there are.

questions.q: There ______ many stars in the sky.
questions.e: many stars 是复数，要用 There are。

questions.q: ______ there any water on Mars?
questions.e: water 是不可数名词，疑问句用 Is there …?。
疑问句把 Are 放到 there 前。

points.title: 用 need to 说明节能行动
points.explain: need to + 动词原形表示「需要做某事」。主语是第三人称单数时用 needs to。也可以用 should + 动词原形给出建议。

examples.en: We need to turn off lights at night.
examples.zh: 我们需要在夜里把灯关掉。

questions.q: We need ______ save energy.
questions.e: need to 后接动词原形 save。

questions.q: Everyone ______ (need) to save water.
questions.e: Everyone 在语法上是单数，用 needs。

questions.q: We should ______ (reuse) bottles.
questions.e: should 后面接动词原形。

points.title: 说出节能与资源再利用的做法
points.explain: 建议或提醒可以用祈使句。肯定形式用动词原形开头，否定形式用 Don't + 动词原形。用 We use … to … 说明能源用途。

examples.en: Turn off the lights. Don't waste water.

questions.q: ______ the lights when you leave the room.
questions.e: 祈使句用动词原形 Turn 开头。

questions.q: ______ waste water.
questions.e: 否定祈使句以 Don't 或 Do not 开头。

questions.q: We use wind power ______ make electricity.
questions.e: 用 to make 表示「用风能发电」的用途。
